gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-fs-public-san: Big, open counters in a tall lowercase give Noto Serif Georgian its literary look. Public Sans sits beneath it with a hefty, trustworthy body, and its broad c and s shapes make the two feel dignified yet approachable.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of crisp text with its letters held open rather than curled shut. Noto Serif Georgian, with thin strokes half its thick ones, adds the dignity.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-general-sans: Dignified is the first impression from Noto Serif Georgian, whose strokes swell only slightly, like a round brush barely pressed. General Sans follows with a smooth, neon-tube consistency and an x-height that fills the line.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-manrope: Noto Serif Georgian carries a gentle weight change where its bowls curve, which gives it a literary, thoughtful air. And Manrope, with its constant-walled o and bright openings, feels friendly and modern beside it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-montserrat: Literary curves, softly swollen. Beneath Noto Serif Georgian, Montserrat glides like wire with oversized e and a counters, and it holds up well when you nudge its size up.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-satoshi: Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, with every stroke cut to a single width. Beside Noto Serif Georgian's letterpress-like swelling, that smoothness stands out.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-switzer: Tall, dignified, gently tapered: that is Noto Serif Georgian, with big counters and stems that narrow toward each joint. Switzer does the opposite job, with wire-like Swiss letterforms whose c tips never creep together.
gen-gf-noto-serif-georgian-work-sans: Contemporary Work Sans meets the literary Noto Serif Georgian, whose crossbars run a bit finer than its stems. The serif handles the dignified voice well, while Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and its strokes free of hairlines.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-archivo: Archivo has a commanding x-height and curves that open outward instead of curling in. And Noto Serif Grantha, with the mild variation of a gently used dip pen, supplies the bookish editorial voice.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-fs-epilogue: Noto Serif Grantha is bookish, with stubby ascenders and a big x-height. Epilogue's wire-like monoline curves feel unclamped beside it, and its tall-bodied lowercase can stay fairly modest in size.
